Class ContentProcessingOptions

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.services.content.ContentProcessingOptions
public class ContentProcessingOptions extends Object
Options passed to a ContentProcessor that only apply to one execution. This options lifespan is only one conversion request. Created: Tue Jan 14 14:34:16 2003
